metadata.title: SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Imports STIX 2.1 threat intelligence indicators from SOCRadar TAXII server into Microsoft Sentinel using Azure Functions. Supports multiple collections, cursor-based pagination, checkpoint/resume, and batch upload.
metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name

Leave false to use a workspace that already exists: the workspace itself is not updated, so its pricing tier, retention and daily cap are never changed, and a name that does not exist fails before anything is created. Set true only to create a new workspace named WorkspaceName; do not set it on an existing workspace that uses a commitment tier. Only honoured when WorkspaceResourceGroup is the deployment resource group. An existing workspace in a different region than WorkspaceLocation fails the deployment with InvalidResourceLocation before anything is created.

Resource group of the Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Leave the default when the workspace is in the resource group you deploy to. Set it when the workspace lives elsewhere: Microsoft Sentinel must already be enabled there, and the audit table and workspace role are created there by a nested deployment.
Location/region of the Log Analytics workspace
Comma-separated SOCRadar TAXII API root names (e.g., radar_alpha,radar_gamma)
Comma-separated TAXII collection UUIDs matching API roots order (e.g., fd3fec42-...,f260cf45-...)
TAXII server username issued by SOCRadar, e.g. radar_330, not the bare company ID
TAXII server password (SOCRadar Platform API Key)
How often to poll TAXII server (5-1440 minutes)
Hours of history to fetch on first run (0 = all history, large collections may take several days to sync via checkpoints)
Function App deployment package. Leave the default unless you are testing a build before it is released.
Enable audit logging to SOCRadar_TAXII_Audit_CL custom table

Create the six SOCRadar TAXII threat hunting analytics rules in Microsoft Sentinel. They match the indicators this product writes against ASIM network, DNS, web, file and process events. Turn off to skip them.
Severity of the alerts the threat hunting rules raise.
Set automatically. Forces the package push to run again on a redeploy, which would otherwise reset WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE and leave the app empty.

threatHuntRules.displayName: SOCRadar TAXII Threat Hunt - IP address contacted
threatHuntRules.description: Correlates outbound network sessions (ASIM _Im_NetworkSession, DstIpAddr) with active IP indicators that the SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 Function App wrote to ThreatIntelIndicators. One alert per matching session.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The SOCRadar TAXII feed lists {{MatchedValue}} ({{IndicatorType}}); it was seen in {{SourceProduct}} telemetry. Confidence, validity, threat labels and collection are in the custom details.

threatHuntRules.query:
let dt_lookBack = 2h;
let ioc_lookBack = 14d;
let Indicators = ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| where ObservableKey == "ipv4-addr:value"
| where isnotempty(ObservableValue)
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(ioc_lookBack)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ObservableValue
| extend Collection = extract(@"collection-([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})", 1, tostring(Tags))
| extend ThreatLabels = strcat_array(set_difference(split(tostring(Tags), ","), dynamic(["socradar", "taxii"]), pack_array(strcat("collection-", Collection))), ", ")
| project IndicatorId = Id, MatchedValue = ObservableValue, MatchKey = tolower(ObservableValue), IndicatorKey = ObservableKey, Confidence, ValidUntil, Collection, ThreatLabels;
_Im_NetworkSession(starttime = ago(dt_lookBack))
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(dt_lookBack)
| where isnotempty(DstIpAddr)
| join kind=inner Indicators on $left.DstIpAddr == $right.MatchKey
| extend IndicatorType = "IP address", InternalIp = SrcIpAddr, HostName = coalesce(SrcHostname, DvcHostname), SourceProduct = EventProduct
| extend LinkToSOCRadar = "https://platform.socradar.com", ProviderName = "SOCRadar"
| project TimeGenerated, IndicatorType, MatchedValue, IndicatorId, Confidence, ValidUntil, Collection, ThreatLabels, InternalIp, HostName, SourceProduct, LinkToSOCRadar, ProviderName

threatHuntRules.displayName: SOCRadar TAXII Threat Hunt - File hash seen
threatHuntRules.description: Correlates file events (ASIM _Im_FileEvent, TargetFileSHA256, TargetFileSHA1 and TargetFileMD5) with active file hash indicators that the SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 Function App wrote to ThreatIntelIndicators. Uses _Im_FileEvent, the unifying parser that is present in every workspace. One alert per matching event.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The SOCRadar TAXII feed lists {{MatchedValue}} ({{IndicatorType}}); it was seen in {{SourceProduct}} telemetry. Confidence, validity, threat labels and collection are in the custom details.

threatHuntRules.query:
let dt_lookBack = 2h;
let ioc_lookBack = 14d;
let Indicators = ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| where ObservableKey in ("file:hashes.sha256", "file:hashes.sha1", "file:hashes.md5")
| where isnotempty(ObservableValue)
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(ioc_lookBack)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where IsActive == true and ValidUntil > now()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ObservableValue
| extend Collection = extract(@"collection-([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})", 1, tostring(Tags))
| extend ThreatLabels = strcat_array(set_difference(split(tostring(Tags), ","), dynamic(["socradar", "taxii"]), pack_array(strcat("collection-", Collection))), ", ")
| project IndicatorId = Id, MatchedValue = ObservableValue, MatchKey = tolower(ObservableValue), IndicatorKey = ObservableKey, Confidence, ValidUntil, Collection, ThreatLabels;
_Im_FileEvent(starttime = ago(dt_lookBack))
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(dt_lookBack)
| extend HashList = pack_array(TargetFileSHA256, TargetFileSHA1, TargetFileMD5)
| mv-expand EventHash = HashList to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(EventHash)
| extend EventHashLower = tolower(EventHash)
| join kind=inner Indicators on $left.EventHashLower == $right.MatchKey
| extend IndicatorType = case(IndicatorKey == "file:hashes.sha256", "SHA256 file hash", IndicatorKey == "file:hashes.sha1", "SHA1 file hash", "MD5 file hash")
| extend HashAlgorithm = case(IndicatorKey == "file:hashes.sha256", "SHA256", IndicatorKey == "file:hashes.sha1", "SHA1", "MD5")
| extend InternalIp = SrcIpAddr, HostName = coalesce(DvcHostname, SrcHostname), FileName = TargetFileName, AccountName = ActorUsername, SourceProduct = EventProduct
| extend LinkToSOCRadar = "https://platform.socradar.com", ProviderName = "SOCRadar"
| project TimeGenerated, IndicatorType, MatchedValue, HashAlgorithm, IndicatorId, Confidence, ValidUntil, Collection, ThreatLabels, FileName, AccountName, InternalIp, HostName, SourceProduct, LinkToSOCRadar, ProviderName

resources.comments: Resolves the existing workspace before any resource is created. A condition:false resource counts as a satisfied dependency in ARM, so depending on the workspace resource itself does not stop the deployment when WorkspaceName does not exist and DeployNewWorkspace is false -- it would create the storage account, the user-assigned identity and the App Service Plan and only then fail. This checks that the workspace EXISTS and nothing else.
resources.name: precheck-workspace-exists

resources.comments: Cross-RG only. This template creates the Microsoft Sentinel solution and the onboarding state only when the workspace is in the deployment resource group, so nothing onboards an external workspace and the deployment would succeed against one with no Microsoft Sentinel on it. onboardingStates/default returns NotFound in exactly that case, which is the polarity reference() can assert. The solution resource alone is not the signal: a workspace can carry it and still have no onboarding state.
resources.name: precheck-external-workspace

properties.scriptContent:
set -e
# key check
if [ -n "$TAXII_USERNAME" ] && [ -n "$TAXII_PASSWORD" ] && [ -n "$API_ROOT" ] && [ -n "$COLLECTION_ID" ]; then
  tuser=$(printf '%s' "$TAXII_USERNAME" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
  tpass=$(printf '%s' "$TAXII_PASSWORD" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
  keycode=$(printf 'user = "%s:%s"\n' "$tuser" "$tpass" | curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 60 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -H 'Accept: application/taxii+json;version=2.1' -K - "https://taxii2.socradar.com/$API_ROOT/collections/$COLLECTION_ID/" || true)
  case "$keycode" in
    200) echo 'the SOCRadar TAXII credentials were accepted' ;;
    401) echo 'SOCRadar TAXII rejected the username or password (HTTP 401): check TAXIIUsername and TAXIIPassword and deploy again' >&2; exit 1 ;;
    *) echo "the SOCRadar TAXII credentials could not be checked (HTTP $keycode), continuing" ;;
  esac
fi
# end key check
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L "$PACKAGE_URL"); [ "$code" = 200 ] || { echo "package URL returned HTTP $code" >&2; exit 1; }; curl -sSL -o /tmp/package.zip "$PACKAGE_URL"; python3 -c "import zipfile;zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/package.zip').testzip()" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'downloaded package is not a readable zip' >&2; exit 1; }; echo "package downloaded: $(stat -c%s /tmp/package.zip) bytes"; echo 'reading the app storage connection while the role assignment propagates'; CONN=; for wait in $(seq 1 8); do CONN=$(az functionapp config appsettings list --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --query "[?name=='AzureWebJobsStorage'].value" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$CONN" ] && break; echo "attempt $wait: the app settings are not readable yet"; sleep 15; done; [ -n "$CONN" ] || { echo 'the app settings stayed unreadable for two minutes: the Website Contributor assignment never became effective' >&2; exit 1; }; SA=$(printf '%s' "$CONN" | sed -n 's/.*AccountName=\([^;]*\).*/\1/p'); [ -n "$SA" ] || { echo 'the app storage connection carries no AccountName' >&2; exit 1; }; echo "staging the package in the app storage account $SA"; pointer() { az functionapp config appsettings list --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --query "[?name=='WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE'].value" -o tsv 2>/dev/null; }; shape() { case "$(pointer)" in *function-releases*) echo blob;; 1) echo one;; '') echo missing;; *) echo other;; esac; }; staged() { [ "$(shape)" = blob ]; }; count() { az rest --method get --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$SUB_ID/resourceGroups/$RG_NAME/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/$FA_NAME/functions?api-version=2023-12-01" --query 'length(value)' -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }; indexed() { n=$(count); case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1;; esac; [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; }; BLOB=package-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).zip; for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do az storage container create --name function-releases --connection-string "$CONN" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if az storage blob upload --container-name function-releases --name "$BLOB" --file /tmp/package.zip --overwrite --connection-string "$CONN" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1; then SAS=$(az storage blob generate-sas --container-name function-releases --name "$BLOB" --permissions r --expiry 2099-12-31T00:00:00Z --connection-string "$CONN" -o tsv 2>/dev/null); { [ -n "$SAS" ] && az functionapp config appsettings set --name "$FA_NAME" --resource-group "$RG_NAME" --settings "WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=https://$SA.blob.core.windows.net/function-releases/$BLOB?$SAS" -o none >/dev/null 2>&1; } || echo "attempt $attempt: no read token was issued for the staged package"; else echo "attempt $attempt: the package upload failed; the readings decide"; fi; echo "attempt $attempt: pointer=$(shape) functions=$(count)";
